32ad5e8.summary: Sets the race text on the card's race labels, with decompiler-mangled trailing code from adjacent CardTextsController methods.

32adc58.summary: Logs a language change, refreshes card texts, and switches an in-hand card's name/description display state to match the text format setting.

32add00.summary: Returns the sorting order of the card's canvas.

32ade70.summary: Shows or hides card visuals, body, highlight, trait icons and created-by text depending on the new card state.

32ae428.summary: Toggles all board trait icons, then (via merged code) cleans up status animation frames and quest frames.

32aed34.summary: Shows the card's description with available-target text appended and updates the card text state.

32ad68c.summary: Sets the 2D card to front view and toggles the 3D body and 2D object visibility.

32ad780.summary: Applies the card art texture and mat-cap texture to the 3D minion renderer's material.

32af194.summary: Switches a card to or from remnant form, toggling the remnant body and hiding lights, anims and counters.

32adfc8.summary: Toggles the 3D body and the effects anchor (hidden for ambush cards).

32af2e0.summary: Creates and returns the DestroyCard coroutine state machine.

32af388.summary: Plays trigger-type trait effect animations for a trait on the card and returns whether any was started.

32af730.summary: Plays or updates the status animation and frame effects for a trait, and toggles flying for flying/vanguard.

32b000c.summary: Sets the flying controller state to flying, landed or in transition based on the option, with merged inlined controller code.

32b00d0.summary: Updates the bastion text on the card, showing the current bastion value or hiding it when zero.

32b01f4.summary: Removes summon sickness visuals: shows can-attack anim and fades in the minion light.

32b02c0.summary: Destroys the can-ability animation object and clears the reference.

32b0330.summary: Creates and returns the SetVanguardStealth coroutine state machine.

32b03e4.summary: Removes status frame effects for a trait, plays exit trait effects, and updates flying state for flying/vanguard.

32ae498.summary: Destroys trait frame effects and the quest frame for the card, optionally clearing all, and stops showing the codex.

32b09d8.summary: Spawns the summon sickness frame effect over the card if not already present.

32b0c0c.summary: Destroys the summon sickness frame object if present.

32b0c9c.summary: Resets a teleported card: re-enables parent, resets alpha on children, and spawns the codex effect object.

32b0df4.summary: Instantiates the codex trait frame effect and parents it to the 2D card controller.

32b10e0.summary: Instantiates the oath trait frame effect and parents it to the 2D card controller.

32b0948.summary: Destroys the codex frame object if present.

32b12c0.summary: Destroys the oath frame object if present.

32b1350.summary: Instantiates the ephemeral (reflected) frame effect and parents it to the 2D card controller.

32b1520.summary: Destroys the reflected frame object if present.

32b15b0.summary: Spawns the stealth frame effect and starts the vanguard stealth coroutine.

32b17a0.summary: Destroys the stealth frame and starts the vanguard stealth-off coroutine.

32ae120.summary: Updates the board trait icons for a unit card, setting icons and counters for each in-play trait; merged with neighbouring methods.

32b18f8.summary: Finds the board trait icon for a trait and plays a scale-punch tween on it (with merged fade code).

32b19e0.summary: Fades all trait icons to a target alpha over a time, with merged blood-thirst flash code.

32b1a58.summary: Makes the blood thirst frame sprite flash with a yoyo fade tween.

32b1b7c.summary: Shows or removes the mulligan-selected frame and plays the toggle sound cue.

32b1e10.summary: Destroys the mulligan selected frame and button frame objects if present.

32b1f04.summary: Creates and returns the DelayedResetMaterial coroutine state machine.

32b1fa8.summary: Applies the dissolve material, plays the invoke animation forward, and starts the delayed material reset coroutine.

32b21c0.summary: Applies the dissolve material, plays the animation in reverse (back to hand), and starts the delayed material reset coroutine.

32b20c0.summary: Returns the legendary or normal dissolve material depending on whether the card uses a legendary summon effect.

32b2308.summary: Shows the damage counter on the card with the damage value and plays its animation.

32b20f8.summary: Sets the card's 3D renderer material (saving the original) and returns the renderer's resulting material.

32b2320.summary: Restores the original 3D renderer material and returns the renderer's resulting material.
